 Before
 Honourable The Chief Justice
 Honourable Mr. Justice Soumitra Saikia
 Order
01.04.2022 Heard Dr. A. Saraf, learned senior counsel appearing for the applicant.

Also heard Mr.
M. Phukan, learned Public Prosecutor, Assam, appearing for respondent nos. 3 and 4.
In our order dated
30.03.2022, passed in WA 116/2022, we had directed that the petitioner be allowed to take possession of the manufactured goods subject to its giving Bank Guarantee of Rs. 1 Crore.

This Interlocutory Application has been filed by the applicant/writ appellant seeking clarification of the aforesaid order dated 30.03.2022, as to in whose favour the Bank Guarantee is to be furnished.

We make it clear that the bank guarantee shall be given in favour of the Deputy Commissioner,
Kamrup (Metro), Guwahati, for a period of one year, which shall be subject to the decision of this court in the connected writ appeal.
Interlocutory Application stands disposed of.
 JUDGE CHIEF JUSTICE
